purpose: Collect matched plywood geometry, thermal-front, and mass histories without treating a measurement convention as a physical shrinkage coefficient.

sources.source: NISTIR 7094 / NIST SP 1021, cone calorimeter appendix
sources.use: 100 mm square horizontal specimen, foil-wrapped non-exposed faces, 25 mm specimen-to-cone-housing distance, 35/70 kW/m2 exposure, spark ignition, three tests, and synchronized mass history.
Controlled irradiance, horizontal orientation, external igniter, sustained-flaming time, heat-release and smoke record context.
Five-frame-per-second optical observation is retained as a documented imaging design choice; its birch-plywood values are not transferred.

sources.source: Rinta-Paavola, Sukhomlinov, and Hostikka, Fire Technology 59 (2023)
sources.use: Keep the interpolated 300 C isotherm as a separate thermal char-front convention and preserve measurement variation.

coordinate_frame.origin: Center of the initial exposed surface before heating.
coordinate_frame.x_axis: Parallel to the face-ply grain direction.
coordinate_frame.y_axis: In the exposed plane, completing a right-handed frame.
coordinate_frame.z_axis: Positive from the initial exposed surface into the specimen toward the unexposed face.
coordinate_frame.surface_displacement_sign: exposed_surface_displacement_m = current_surface_z_m; recession is positive and outward swelling is negative.
coordinate_frame.depth_reference: All thermocouple depths are surveyed from the initial exposed surface; optical depth is additionally reported from the current exposed surface.

timebase.time_zero_event: exposure_start, when the protective shutter clears the specimen.
timebase.timestamp_rule: Every instrument record uses elapsed_time_s from the master clock; camera clocks require a recorded synchronization event and offset.

apparatus_contract.method: ISO 5660-1 / ASTM E1354 compatible cone calorimeter operated by the responsible laboratory.

thermal_front_instrumentation.sensor_type: Fine-wire thermocouples compatible with the laboratory fire-test SOP; type, wire diameter, junction construction, and calibration are recorded per run.
thermal_front_instrumentation.placement: Central region, away from edges; lateral insertion path and junction coordinates are photographed and recorded.
thermal_front_instrumentation.front_rule: Interpolate depth at 300 C only between valid surveyed junctions that bracket 300 C at the requested time. Never extrapolate beyond the outer valid junctions.

optical_instrumentation.surface_view: Orthogonal calibrated side view containing a fixed reference tied to the specimen holder and the initial z=0 plane.
optical_instrumentation.section_view: Post-stabilization orthogonal cross-section image with an in-plane traceable scale and run identifier.
optical_instrumentation.front_rule: Trace current exposed surface and visible char/pyrolysis boundary independently; retain raw trace points and operator identifier.

acquisition_contract.missing_or_invalid_values: blank or null; never replace with zero

interruption_contract.exposure_end: Insert the apparatus shutter at the scheduled interruption time and record the actual exposure_end timestamp.
interruption_contract.quench: The laboratory must approve and record one fixed quench method during the pilot. Record quench_start, quench_complete, medium, enclosure, and specimen-contact details; do not infer instantaneous cooling.
interruption_contract.handling: Keep the specimen in its holder until quench_complete unless the approved SOP requires otherwise; record every move and contact.
interruption_contract.sectioning: Section only after the approved stabilization criterion is met. Record section plane, saw kerf, material loss, and elapsed time since exposure_end.

external_authorization_gate.policy: This repository defines data and synchronization acceptance. It does not authorize a fire test or replace the laboratory safety SOP.
